turns.text: Which of our customer groups are worth what we pay to acquire them? Look at the 2024 sign-ups.

csvChecks.ask: cohorts.csv with columns channel,cohort,customers,cac_gbp,gp_12m_gbp,ltv_to_cac,churn_12m_pct: one row per channel and half-year of 2024 sign-ups (cohort 2024-H1 or 2024-H2), with CAC, gross profit per customer over their first 12 months (the sign-up month and the 11 after), its ratio to CAC, and the % whose last billed month came before their 12th month (so they weren't billed for all 12)
